import hashlib, importlib.util, json, sys
from pathlib import Path
root = Path(importlib.util.find_spec("vllm").origin).parent
if not str(root).startswith("/opt/venv/"):
    raise RuntimeError(f"unexpected serving package: {root}")
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("verification", "/profile/patch_verification.py")
overlay = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(overlay)
source = (root / overlay.RELATIVE_PATH).read_text()
if overlay.MARKER not in source or overlay.patch_text(source) != source:
    raise RuntimeError("installed verification overlay is not an exact replay")
hashes = {p: hashlib.sha256((root / p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
          for p in (*overlay.DEPENDENCY_SHA256, overlay.RELATIVE_PATH)}
for path, expected in overlay.DEPENDENCY_SHA256.items():
    if hashes[path] != expected:
        raise RuntimeError(f"installed verification dependency changed: {path}")
print(json.dumps({"python": sys.executable, "root": str(root), "hashes": hashes}))
